explanation.en: The Public Accounts Committee (PAC), consisting of 22 members (15 from Lok Sabha, 7 from Rajya Sabha), scrutinizes the audit reports submitted by the CAG. The CAG acts as a 'friend, philosopher, and guide' to the PAC.

explanation.en: Under Section 45ZB of the amended RBI Act 1934, the Monetary Policy Committee consists of 6 members: three from the RBI (including the Governor as Chairperson) and three appointed by the Central Government.
explanation.hi: आरबीआई अधिनियम 1934 की धारा 45ZB के तहत मौद्रिक नीति समिति (MPC) में 6 सदस्य होते हैं (3 आरबीआई से, जिसमें गवर्नर अध्यक्ष होते हैं, और 3 केंद्र सरकार द्वारा नियुक्त)।

explanation.en: Article 279A, inserted by the 101st Constitutional Amendment Act 2016, empowers the President to constitute the GST Council, chaired by the Union Finance Minister.
explanation.hi: 101वें संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम, 2016 द्वारा जोड़े गए अनुच्छेद 279A के तहत राष्ट्रपति द्वारा जीएसटी परिषद का गठन किया गया, जिसकी अध्यक्षता केंद्रीय वित्त मंत्री करते हैं।

question.en: According to Lindeman's Ten Percent Law in ecology, what percentage of energy is transferred from one trophic level to the next?

question.hinglish: According to Lindeman's Ten Percent Law in ecology, what percentage of energy is transferred from one trophic level to the next?

explanation.en: Raymond Lindeman's 10% law dictates that roughly 10% of stored energy is passed on to organisms at the next trophic level; the remaining 90% is consumed in metabolic activities or dissipated as heat.
explanation.hi: रेमंड लिंडमैन (1942) के नियम के अनुसार, एक पोषण स्तर से अगले स्तर पर केवल 10% ऊर्जा का स्थानांतरण होता है, जबकि 90% ऊर्जा श्वसन और चयापचय में खर्च होकर ऊष्मा के रूप में नष्ट हो जाती है।
explanation.hinglish: Raymond Lindeman's 10% law dictates that roughly 10% of stored energy is passed on to organisms at the next trophic level; the remaining 90% is consumed in metabolic activities or dissipated as heat.

explanation.en: Rocket propulsion is a classic application of Newton's third law and the conservation of linear momentum: the backward momentum of high-velocity expelled gases imparts an equal forward momentum to the rocket.

question.en: Optical fibres used in modern high-speed telecommunication operate on which optical principle?
question.hi: आधुनिक उच्च-गति दूरसंचार में प्रयुक्त ऑप्टिकल फाइबर किस प्रकाशिक सिद्धांत पर कार्य करते हैं?
question.hinglish: Optical fibres used in modern high-speed telecommunication operate on which optical principle?

options.en: Total Internal Reflection
options.hi: पूर्ण आंतरिक परावर्तन (Total Internal Reflection)
options.hinglish: Total Internal Reflection

options.en: Diffraction of light
options.hi: प्रकाश का विवर्तन
options.hinglish: Diffraction of light

options.en: Polarization of light
options.hi: प्रकाश का ध्रुवण
options.hinglish: Polarization of light

options.en: Scattering of light
options.hi: प्रकाश का प्रकीर्णन
options.hinglish: Scattering of light

explanation.en: Optical fibres transmit data as light signals through total internal reflection occurring repeatedly inside a high-refractive-index glass or plastic core surrounded by a lower-index cladding.
explanation.hi: ऑप्टिकल फाइबर पूर्ण आंतरिक परावर्तन (TIR) के सिद्धांत पर कार्य करते हैं, जहाँ प्रकाश किरणें उच्च अपवर्तनांक वाले कोर के भीतर बिना किसी ऊर्जा हानि के परावर्तित होती रहती हैं।

question.en: Which cellular organelle is universally referred to as the 'Suicidal Bag' of the cell due to its destructive digestive enzymes?
question.hi: किस कोशिकांग को अपने पाचक एंजाइमों की उपस्थिति के कारण कोशिका की 'आत्मघाती थैली' (Suicidal Bag) कहा जाता है?
question.hinglish: Which cellular organelle is universally referred to as the 'Suicidal Bag' of the cell due to its destructive digestive enzymes?

options.en: Lysosome
options.hi: लाइसोसोम (Lysosome)
options.hinglish: Lysosome

options.en: Mitochondrion
options.hi: माइटोकॉन्ड्रिया
options.hinglish: Mitochondrion

options.en: Ribosome
options.hi: राइबोसोम
options.hinglish: Ribosome

options.en: Golgi apparatus
options.hi: गॉल्जी काय
options.hinglish: Golgi apparatus

explanation.en: Lysosomes contain strong hydrolytic enzymes capable of digesting cellular components. When a cell is damaged, lysosomes may burst and digest their own cell, earning the name 'suicidal bags'.
explanation.hi: लाइसोसोम में शक्तिशाली जल-अपघटकीय (hydrolytic) एंजाइम होते हैं। कोशिकीय चयापचय में व्यवधान के कारण जब कोशिका क्षतिग्रस्त होती है, तो लाइसोसोम फट जाते हैं और अपनी ही कोशिका का पाचन कर लेते हैं।

explanation.en: O-negative blood lacks A, B antigens on red cells and also lacks the Rh factor, allowing it to be safely transfused to patients of any blood type in emergencies.

explanation.en: Aditya-L1 is stationed in a halo orbit around Lagrange Point 1 (L1) of the Sun-Earth system, approximately 1.5 million km from Earth, allowing uninterrupted view of the Sun without eclipses.

question.hinglish: Where is the principal judicial organ of the United Nations, the International Court of Justice (ICJ), permanently seated?

options.hinglish: Vienna, Austria

explanation.en: The International Court of Justice (ICJ) is seated at the Peace Palace in The Hague, Netherlands, making it the only one of the six principal UN organs not located in New York.
explanation.hi: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय न्यायालय (ICJ) नीदरलैंड के द हेग में स्थित पीस पैलेस में स्थित है। यह संयुक्त राष्ट्र के छह प्रमुख अंगों में से एकमात्र ऐसा अंग है जो न्यूयॉर्क में स्थित नहीं है।

explanation.en: In Dravidian architecture, the colossal multi-tiered gateway towers leading into the temple enclosure are called Gopurams, while the tower directly above the sanctum sanctorum is called the Vimana.
explanation.hi: द्रविड़ स्थापत्य शैली में मंदिर परिसर के भव्य प्रवेश द्वार को 'गोपुरम' कहा जाता है, जबकि गर्भगृह के ऊपर स्थित पिरामिडनुमा मीनार को 'विमान' कहा जाता है।

question.en: Whose signature appears on the One Rupee currency note issued in India?
question.hi: भारत में जारी किए जाने वाले एक रुपये के करेंसी नोट पर किसके हस्ताक्षर होते हैं?
question.hinglish: Whose signature appears on the One Rupee currency note issued in India?

options.en: Finance Secretary, Government of India
options.hi: वित्त सचिव, भारत सरकार (Finance Secretary)
options.hinglish: Finance Secretary, Government of India

options.en: Governor, Reserve Bank of India
options.hi: गवर्नर, भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक
options.hinglish: Governor, Reserve Bank of India

options.en: Finance Minister of India
options.hi: भारत के वित्त मंत्री
options.hinglish: Finance Minister of India

options.en: Prime Minister of India
options.hi: भारत के प्रधानमंत्री
options.hinglish: Prime Minister of India

explanation.en: Under the Coinage Act, the One Rupee note is issued directly by the Ministry of Finance, Government of India, and bears the signature of the Finance Secretary, while all other banknotes bear the signature of the RBI Governor.
explanation.hi: सिक्का निर्माण अधिनियम के तहत एक रुपये का नोट भारत सरकार के वित्त मंत्रालय द्वारा जारी किया जाता है और इस पर वित्त सचिव के हस्ताक्षर होते हैं, जबकि अन्य सभी नोटों पर आरबीआई गवर्नर के हस्ताक्षर होते हैं।

question.en: In the landmark 2019 SI redefinition by the BIPM, the kilogram was redefined in terms of which fundamental physical constant?
question.hi: BIPM द्वारा 2019 में किए गए ऐतिहासिक एसआई पुनर्परिभाषाकरण में किलोग्राम को किस मौलिक भौतिक स्थिरांक के आधार पर पुनर्परिभाषित किया गया?
question.hinglish: In the landmark 2019 SI redefinition by the BIPM, the kilogram was redefined in terms of which fundamental physical constant?

options.en: Planck's constant (h)
options.hi: प्लांक नियतांक (Planck's constant - h)
options.hinglish: Planck's constant (h)

options.en: Speed of light in vacuum (c)
options.hi: निर्वात में प्रकाश की चाल (c)
options.hinglish: Speed of light in vacuum (c)

options.en: Boltzmann constant (k)
options.hi: बोल्ट्जमान नियतांक (k)
options.hinglish: Boltzmann constant (k)

options.en: Elementary charge (e)
options.hi: मूल विद्युत आवेश (e)

explanation.en: On May 20, 2019 (World Metrology Day), the physical prototype IPK cylinder was retired, and the kilogram was officially redefined by fixing the exact numerical value of the Planck constant h to 6.62607015 × 10^-34 J·s.

explanation.en: The SI derived unit of electrical capacitance is the Farad (F), named after Michael Faraday. One farad is defined as the capacitance across which one coulomb of charge causes a potential difference of one volt (1 F = 1 C/V).
explanation.hi: विद्युत धारिता का एसआई मात्रक फैराड (F) है। एक फैराड वह धारिता है जिसमें एक कूलॉम आवेश प्रवाहित होने पर एक वोल्ट का विभवांतर उत्पन्न होता है (1 F = 1 C/V)।

evidence.quote: The Sutlej River enters India from Tibet through Shipki La pass in the Kinnaur district of Himachal Pradesh.

factCards.canonicalStatement: Anamudi in the Anaimalai Hills of Kerala stands at 2,695 meters, making it the highest peak in Peninsular India and the Western Ghats.

evidence.quote: Anamudi in the Anaimalai Hills of Kerala stands at 2,695 meters, making it the highest peak in Peninsular India and the Western Ghats.

factCards.canonicalStatement: The Chenab, formed by the confluence of Chandra and Bhaga rivers near Tandi in Himachal Pradesh, is the largest tributary of the Indus.
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: हिमाचल प्रदेश में तांडी के पास चंद्रा और भागा नदियों के संगम से बनने वाली चिनाब (चंद्रभागा) नदी, सिंधु की सबसे बड़ी सहायक नदी है।

evidence.quote: The Chenab, formed by the confluence of Chandra and Bhaga rivers near Tandi in Himachal Pradesh, is the largest tributary of the Indus.

factCards.canonicalStatement: At Devprayag in Uttarakhand, the Bhagirathi meets the Alaknanda. Below this confluence, the river is officially called the Ganga.

evidence.quote: At Devprayag in Uttarakhand, the Bhagirathi meets the Alaknanda. Below this confluence, the river is officially called the Ganga.

factCards.canonicalStatement: The Godavari, with a length of 1,465 km, is the longest peninsular river in India. It originates at Trimbakeshwar in Maharashtra and drains into the Bay of Bengal.
factCards.canonicalStatementHindi: 1,465 किमी लंबी गोदावरी भारत की सबसे लंबी प्रायद्वीपीय नदी है। यह महाराष्ट्र के त्र्यंबकेश्वर से निकलकर बंगाल की खाड़ी में गिरती है।

evidence.quote: The Narmada River flows westward in a linear rift valley formed between the Vindhyan range to the north and the Satpura range to the south.
